cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

lucidchain.checkpoint.v1.Checkpoint.description:
Checkpoint is a finalized commitment submitted by a registered sidechain.
It stores only cryptographic commitments -- never raw application data.

checkpoint_hash.description: SHA-256 over the sign bytes of CheckpointSignDoc (see below).

data_pointer.description: Optional off-chain pointer (IPFS CID, URI). Covered by the signatures, not verified on-chain.

previous_checkpoint_hash.description:
Hash of the immediately preceding checkpoint for this sidechain,
forming a verifiable chain. Empty for sequence == 1.

record_count.description:
Number of individual records/events committed in this batch.
Informational; used for fee calculation and monitoring, not consensus-critical.

sequence.description:
Monotonically increasing sequence number for this sidechain's checkpoints.
Must equal the previous checkpoint's sequence + 1 (no gaps, no reordering).

sidechain_id.description: ID of the sidechain this checkpoint belongs to (see x/sidechain.Sidechain.id).

signatures_digest.description:
SHA-256 of the concatenation of the verified signatures, ordered by
signer_index. Lets an auditor holding the original signatures prove they
are the ones the chain accepted, without storing ~3.3 KB per signer.

signer_bitmap.description:
Bit i set => the key at Sidechain.signer_keys[i] (at signer_set_version)
produced a valid signature. Length = ceil(len(signer_keys) / 8).

signer_set_version.description: Sidechain.signer_set_version under which this checkpoint was verified.

state_root.description:
Merkle root (or equivalent state commitment) of the batch of records
this checkpoint covers, as computed off-chain by the sidechain.

lucidchain.checkpoint.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the module.

base_fee.description: Base fee per checkpoint submission, in the native token's smallest denom.

max_data_pointer_bytes.description: Maximum size in bytes of the data_pointer field.

max_records_per_checkpoint.description: Maximum record_count allowed to be declared in a single checkpoint.

max_signature_bytes_per_checkpoint.description:
Upper bound on total signature bytes in one message. With ML-DSA-65
(3309 B/sig), 7 signatures is ~23 KB; size this together with the block
max_bytes consensus param and charge gas per signature verified.

max_signatures_per_checkpoint.description: Upper bound on signatures in one message.

per_record_fee.description: Additional fee per record in the batch (record_count), to price large batches fairly.

lucidchain.sidechain.v1.AssuranceTier.description:
AssuranceTier defines the level of validation a sidechain has registered for.

 - ASSURANCE_TIER_NOTARIZED: Tier 1: timestamped commitment only
 - ASSURANCE_TIER_ATTESTED: Tier 2: notarized + attestor sign-off
 - ASSURANCE_TIER_PROVEN: Tier 3: notarized + validity proof verification

lucidchain.sidechain.v1.Params.description: Params defines module-wide parameters, settable via governance.

allowed_pubkey_type_urls.description:
Protobuf type URLs of public keys accepted as checkpoint signers, e.g.
"/cosmos.crypto.mldsa65.PubKey". For a quantum-resistant deployment set this
to ML-DSA-65 only; adding classical types (ed25519, secp256k1) re-opens the
sidechain to quantum forgery of its checkpoint signatures.

max_signer_keys.description:
Maximum signer keys per sidechain. ML-DSA-65 pubkeys are 1952 bytes each,
so this directly bounds per-sidechain state size.

min_bond_by_tier.description: One entry per tier; Validate() rejects duplicates and UNSPECIFIED.

lucidchain.sidechain.v1.QueryParamsRespo.description: QueryParamsResponse is response type for the Query/Params RPC method.

params.description: params holds all the parameters of this module.

lucidchain.sidechain.v1.Sidechain.description: Sidechain is the on-chain registration record for a private sidechain.

bond.description: Bond posted at registration (amount and denom).

checkpoint_interval_seconds.description: Expected interval between checkpoints, in seconds.

last_checkpoint_sequence.description:
Owned by x/sidechain; updated by x/checkpoint via the expected-keeper call
RecordCheckpoint. Zero / empty until the first checkpoint is accepted.

name.description: Human-readable name, shown in explorers and dashboards.

operator.description: Bech32 address of the sidechain operator (registration owner, admin actions).

signature_threshold.description: Minimum number of distinct signers required per checkpoint.

signer_keys.description:
Keys authorized to sign checkpoints, as SDK public keys. Post-quantum
deployments use /cosmos.crypto.mldsa65.PubKey (ML-DSA-65, FIPS 204).
Allowed type URLs are restricted by Params.allowed_pubkey_type_urls.
Order is significant: Signature.signer_index refers to a position in this list.

signer_set_version.description:
Incremented on every change to signer_keys or signature_threshold.
Checkpoints record the version they were signed under, so signer indices
stay unambiguous across rotations.

lucidchain.sidechain.v1.SidechainStatus.description:
SidechainStatus defines the lifecycle state of a registered sidechain.

 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_PENDING: registered, bond posted, awaiting activation
 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_ACTIVE: accepting checkpoints
 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_SUSPENDED: temporarily halted (e.g. missed interval, dispute)
 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_SLASHED: bond slashed for a provable fault
 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_EXITED: voluntarily deregistered, bond returned after cooldown

lucidchain.sidechain.v1.TierBond.description: TierBond is the minimum bond for one assurance tier.
